reviews.text: The products in this travel case are all really nice. They smell pleasant, absorb nicely, and are very hydrating. I suffer from hormonal acne so I wanted to see how effective these products would be in reducing scars and hyperpigmentation. I have tried the products for a few days now and notice a little bit of improvement in my skin's texture and it is not as red as it was before.
reviews.zh: 呢個旅行裝入面嘅產品都好好。佢哋香味好舒服，吸收好，保濕力好強。我有荷爾蒙痘，所以想睇吓呢啲產品喺減淡痘疤同色素沉澱方面有幾有效。我用咗呢啲產品幾日，見到皮膚質地有少少改善，而且冇之前咁紅。

reviews.text:
I bought this for my myself. My skin is a bit sensitive. I tried for couple of times and noticed some irritation and breakouts. I totally stopped using it but my husband absolutely loves it. He has been using it regionally and can seriously notices some changes that it claims for. 

Absolutely love this line currently I am using AHA BHA PHA kit and I also love that.
reviews.zh:
我係買畀自己用嘅。我嘅皮膚有少少敏感。我試咗幾次，發現有啲刺激同爆痘。我完全停咗用，但係我老公好鍾意。佢一直局部使用，而且真係見到產品聲稱嘅一啲改變。

我而家真係好鍾意呢個系列，我而家用緊 AHA BHA PHA 套裝，我都好鍾意。

reviews.text: I tried the set of Yuja before and didn't go well on my skin. Now these are talking nicely to me :) My skin becomes healthier tighter and less acne. Just one more thing that it's not that hydrate to me. You might need another moisturiser to top before bed. Still recommend to try. I have sensitive plus combination skin type.
reviews.zh: 我之前試過柚子套裝，但對我嘅皮膚唔啱。而家呢套就好啱我 :) 我嘅皮膚變得更健康、更緊緻，暗瘡都少咗。唯一一樣嘢係，對我嚟講保濕唔係幾夠。你瞓前可能需要再搽一款保濕霜。不過仍然推薦大家試吓。我嘅皮膚屬敏感加混合性。

reviews.text: I brought this last year where I was really struggling with my skin. The products are travel size which last about 1 month with the serum finishing first and the face wash last. Nothing was sticky or irritating, very gentle on the skin. Highly recommend it, plus you get to try a variety of products without huge commitment.
reviews.zh: 我去年買咗呢套，當時我嘅皮膚真係好煩惱。呢套係旅行裝，用大約一個月，精華最先用完，潔面產品最後用完。冇任何產品黏或者刺激，對皮膚好溫和。非常推薦，而且你可以試多種產品，唔使一次過投入好多金錢。

reviews.text:
I bought this for my mother because I thought that the ingredients would suit her skin.
My mother is a 46 year old woman, her skin is a bit sensitive and mature.

Like I was expecting her skin looks a lot better and I have been helping her with the products and doing a facial massage to her after putting the products on her face.

She has nice skin for someone who never did skincare but she lately have been getting wrinkles on her forehead but thanks to this product her skin had improved and so the wrinkles are reducing and its been only 4 days since we received the products.

I am using AHA BHA PHA kit and I also loved.
reviews.zh:
我係買畀我媽媽嘅，因為我覺得呢啲成分啱佢嘅皮膚。
我媽媽 46 歲，佢嘅皮膚有少少敏感，而且有啲成熟。

正如我所料，佢嘅皮膚變好咗好多。我一直幫佢用呢啲產品，並且喺佢塗完產品之後，幫佢做面部按摩。

佢從前從來冇護膚過，但皮膚都幾好；不過最近佢額頭開始有皺紋，多得呢款產品，佢嘅皮膚有咗改善，皺紋都減少咗，而我哋收到產品至今只係四日。

我都有用 AHA BHA PHA 套裝，我都好鍾意。

reviews.text:
I love every product in this set. The Cleanser is so gentle yet effective, the toner hydrates and soothes, the serumn is not too sticky and nourishing and the cream is light enough to used in the day but still moisturizes very well. 

Works really well on my oily skin when I'm using strong actives - excellent for dry and sensitive skin too.
reviews.zh:
我好鍾意呢套產品嘅每一款。潔面產品好溫和，但效果好好；爽膚水保濕又舒緩；精華唔會太黏，有滋養效果；面霜夠輕，日間都可以用，但保濕力仍然好好。

當我用強效活性成分嗰陣，佢哋對我嘅油性皮膚效果都好好——對乾性同敏感皮膚都非常好。

reviews.text: I tried before the cleansing gel and liked it so much it pushed me to try the rest of the line. Best decision ever. The toner is really nice and the serum really makes a difference for my dehydrated acne prone skin, but what I loved the most is the moisturizer. Amazing!! Had troubles for a long time trying to find a moisturizer suitable for my skin, even if it was recommended for my exact skin type, it always felt too greasy after some time, or not enough hydration, some even felt like somehow worsened the irritation of my acne. But this one is just perfect!! Hydrates my skin beautifully, soothing my skin in general and helping with the acne, feels perfect, not greasy at all and still my skin feels supple and plumped.
reviews.zh: 我之前試過潔面啫喱，好鍾意，所以試埋呢個系列嘅其他產品。係我做過最正確嘅決定。爽膚水好好用，精華對我呢種缺水又易生暗瘡嘅皮膚真係有效，但我最鍾意嘅係保濕霜。好正！！我好耐以嚟都搵唔到啱我皮膚嘅保濕霜，即使有人話啱我呢個膚質，用咗一段時間都會覺得太油，或者保濕唔夠，有啲甚至令我嘅暗瘡更加刺激。但呢款真係完美！！保濕效果好好，整體都舒緩我嘅皮膚，對暗瘡都有幫助，感覺好完美，一啲都唔油膩，而且皮膚仍然柔潤飽滿。

reviews.text: I was so so curious with this brand. I have old acne scar (15 years).. and I tried so many products even remedies for a long period of time and never work. Then I tried this set to see any progress after I heard rave from many southeast Asian countries. It worked after 3 days!!! And I totally satisfied and excited to see more. So, I take my picture everyday to see progress journey to get rid my acne scar. Thanks Some by Mi!!!!!
reviews.zh: 我好好奇呢個品牌。我有舊痘疤（15 年），試過好多產品甚至偏方，長期都冇效。然後聽到好多東南亞國家嘅人都狂讚，我就試吓呢套，睇吓有冇進展。用咗三日就見效！！！我好滿意，亦都好期待會見到更多改善。所以我每日都影相，記錄我祛除痘疤嘅進展過程。多謝 Some by Mi！！！！！

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
